sufficient_mechanism: An antiunitary Theta with Theta squared equal to minus identity and commuting with the Hermitian transfer Gram operator forces even spectral multiplicity and a squared complex determinant.
positive_zero_obstruction: For a positive analytic Gram family, each vanishing Kramers eigenvalue has even order, so its paired complex-determinant contribution has order divisible by four; Xi squared at a simple Xi zero has order two.
hostile_control: A real structure with square plus identity permits diag(x,y) and determinant xy, so it does not force a square.
xi_audit: Critical-line conjugation and functional-equation reflection supply square plus identity, not Kramers symmetry.
open_target: If the symplectic lane survives, construct its oriented section on the indefinite pre-quotient rather than imposing Kramers symmetry on the positive Gram operator.
status: square-forcing mechanism rejected on the positive Gram space; indefinite pre-quotient lift open
